about: Triggering evals (A9). expect: 'trigger' = this skill should fire; 'route' = a sibling should fire instead (named in 'to'); 'no-trigger' = nothing here. Run by reading each prompt cold and checking which skill's description matches.

cases.prompt: analyze the Horizon theme and extract its design tokens
pull the colors, fonts and spacing out of the theme into the manifest
what design tokens does this theme define?
extract the theme's typography and radii
now create the Figma variables and text styles from those tokens
connect my store URL and Figma file to get started
